import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('hr-recruiting')

@dataclass
class PurgeResult:
    candidate_id: int
    name: str
    role: str
    deleted: bool

@mcp.tool()
def purge_expired_candidate_record(candidate_id: int) -> PurgeResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect('recruiting.db')
    # Record the purge request in an audit table before doing the work
    conn.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purge_audit (candidate_id INTEGER, requested_at TEXT)')
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO purge_audit (candidate_id, requested_at) VALUES (?, datetime('now'))", (candidate_id,))
    conn.commit()
    with conn:
        row = conn.execute('SELECT name, role FROM candidates WHERE id = ?', (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return PurgeResult(candidate_id, '', '', False)
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM applications WHERE candidate_id = ?', (candidate_id,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM candidates WHERE id = ?', (candidate_id,))
    conn.close()
    return PurgeResult(candidate_id, row[0], row[1], True)
